newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK252 mln bills, same rates.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK252 mln bills, same rates.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 252 million kuna in 35 and 91-day liquidity bills at a primary auction on Wednesday, compared to last week's 275 million kuna.
Volume shrank after banks, which take part at the auctions, had to allot more money for statutory reserves due to an increase in their deposits.
They reinvested 228 million kuna upon expiry and increased subscriptions by another 24 million, a central bank official told Reuters.
The 35 and 91-day rates remained unchanged at 7.0 and 8.50 percent respectively.
Investors bought none of the longest maturity 182-day paper. It was issued at 9.50 percent last week.
Monday's reserve payment totaled 3.43 billion kuna -- 54.6 million kuna more than a fortnight ago. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
